It is also suitable for installation in places where a conventional fence cannot be used. It consists of a transmitting generator, a receiver and an antenna in the form of an insulated wire. The transmitting generator generates a signal to the antenna wire, which you use to set the boundaries of the warning and correction zones. The receiver, which is attached to the dog's collar, senses the signal from the antenna wire. If the dog crosses the boundary of the first alert band, the receiver will start to emit an intermittent sound signal. If the dog does not respond to the audible warning and crosses the boundary of the second band, the receiver triggers an audible signal and a correction pulse, which the dog perceives as a very unpleasant sensation on the neck.
